brake_front_lever.name: Front brake lever
brake_front_lever.description: Right-hand handlebar lever. Squeezing it pulls the inner brake cable, which turns the cam arm at the front hub.
faults: Too much free play: cable stretched or shoes worn, adjust or inspect
Lever stiff or slow to return: dry or frayed cable, dry pivot bolt

brake_front_lever_bracket.name: Front brake lever bracket
brake_front_lever_bracket.description: Clamps to the handlebar and holds the lever pivot, the cable end and the cable adjuster.
faults: Loose clamp lets the lever rotate on the bar

brake_front_cable.name: Front brake cable
brake_front_cable.material: Steel inner wire, plastic-lined outer casing
brake_front_cable.description: Transfers the pull from the lever down to the cam arm. The adjuster at the hub end sets lever free play.
faults: Frayed strands: replace immediately
Sticky or rough action: lubricate or replace
Stretched: free play keeps increasing

brake_front_cam_arm.name: Front brake cam arm
brake_front_cam_arm.description: Lever on the outside of the backing plate, splined to the cam. The cable pulls it, rotating the cam inside the drum.
faults: Arm angle past 90 degrees to the cable at full pull means worn shoes and lost leverage

brake_front_cam.name: Front brake cam
brake_front_cam.description: Flat-sided shaft through the backing plate. When it turns, its edges push the shoe ends apart so the linings press on the drum.
faults: Dry or corroded cam sticks, so the brake drags or releases slowly

brake_front_shoe_leading.name: Front brake shoe (leading)
brake_front_shoe_leading.material: Alloy shoe with bonded friction lining
brake_front_shoe_leading.description: The shoe whose cam end meets the drum surface first as the wheel turns. Drum rotation drags it harder into contact, so it does most of the braking.
faults: Worn lining: weak braking, long lever travel
Oil or grease on lining: poor braking, replace shoes
Glazed lining: poor bite, often after overheating

brake_front_shoe_trailing.name: Front brake shoe (trailing)
brake_front_shoe_trailing.material: Alloy shoe with bonded friction lining
brake_front_shoe_trailing.description: The second shoe. Drum rotation pushes it away from the surface, so it brakes less than the leading shoe. This is why the design is called single leading shoe (SLS).
faults: Worn or contaminated lining, as for the leading shoe

brake_front_return_spring.name: Front brake shoe return springs
brake_front_return_spring.description: Pair of springs that pull the shoes back together and away from the drum when the lever is released.
faults: Weak or stretched springs: brake drags, hub gets hot

brake_front_anchor_pin.name: Front brake anchor pin
brake_front_anchor_pin.description: Fixed pin on the backing plate opposite the cam. The shoes pivot on it, and it carries the braking force into the backing plate.
faults: Worn pin lets the shoes shift, causing uneven wear

brake_front_backing_plate.name: Front brake backing plate
brake_front_backing_plate.description: Cover on one side of the hub that holds the cam, anchor pin and shoes. A slot or stop on the fork leg stops it rotating with the wheel.
faults: Damaged anchoring slot or stop: plate can shift under braking

brake_front_drum.name: Front hub and brake drum
brake_front_drum.material: Cast iron liner in alloy hub
brake_front_drum.description: The hub turns with the wheel. Its inner surface is the drum that the shoes press against.
faults: Scored surface: grinding noise, fast shoe wear
Out of round: pulsing lever or judder when braking

brake_front_wear_indicator.name: Front brake wear indicator (if fitted)
brake_front_wear_indicator.description: Pointer on the cam and a scale mark on the backing plate. When the pointer reaches the limit mark with the brake applied, the shoes need replacing.

wheel_front_tyre.name: Front tyre
wheel_front_tyre.description: 3.00 x 17 tyre. Its grip on the road is what finally turns braking force into slowing down.
faults: Low pressure or worn tread reduces braking grip
Cracked sidewalls on an old tyre: replace

wheel_front_rim.name: Front rim
wheel_front_rim.description: 17-inch spoked rim that holds the tyre and is laced to the hub.
faults: Dents or runout cause wobble, worst under braking

wheel_front_spokes.name: Front spokes
wheel_front_spokes.description: Wire spokes carry load between rim and hub, including the braking torque from the drum.
faults: Loose spokes: dull sound when tapped, wheel goes out of true
